name: cppcheck
description: Cppcheck: static analyzer for C and C++ (undefined behavior, bounds, null pointers, leaks).
title: cppcheck

llmHints.on_match: Cppcheck invocation observed. --output-format=sarif --output-file=<file>.sarif is captured by the sarif attestor. It exits 0 on findings unless --error-exitcode=1 is given, and Cppcheck 2.17 (Debian 13) writes its error severity as SARIF level warning (2.21 writes error), so gate on the command-run exit code, not only on an error-level SARIF result.

negativeSetup: Invoke cilock with unrelated argv (e.g. `echo unrelated`)
